note: LA11 tool-calling set (PLAN D28 unit L1, agent design 5.2). Each case is one prompt for a model with four tools: the clock, the calculator, web_search and fetch_url (the page reader). The clock and the calculator are the real tools. web_search and fetch_url answer the fixtureResult text: the facts in it are invented, so a right answer proves the model read the tool result and did not guess. expectTool null means the prompt needs no tool. mustContain: every entry must be in the answer (ignoring case and accents); 'a|b' accepts either. Placeholders {year}, {month}, {weekday} come from the clock at run time. argsContain: text the expected call's arguments must hold. Run by AgentToolEvalSmokeTests (GGUF, model-smoke.yml) and AgentEvalDeviceTests (Apple and MLX, opt-in).
